major_cooldowns.name: Recklessness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown and spam Rampage inside it, since Rampage costs far less here and Bloodbath and Crushing Blow take over your normal buttons.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1719 is both the cast and the self aura in the sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Avatar
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Macro it to Recklessness and press both together, since Anger Management keeps their cooldowns in step.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 107574 is castable per its tooltip but was not pressed in the sampled parses, which all ran Slayer. Mountain Thane build.

major_cooldowns.name: Bladestorm
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Rampage your rage down first, then Bladestorm inside Recklessness, and only delay it when adds are seconds away.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 446035 is the Fury Bladestorm cast id, cast in 5/5 sampled parses; the guide links 227847, a same-name row not seen in casts. Slayer only.

major_cooldowns.name: Odyn's Fury
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown for the free Enrage, and lead with it when a pack is up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 385060 is the observed cast id; the 45s base cooldown sits on same-name row 385059, which the guide links.

major_cooldowns.name: Champion's Spear
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Throw it into a stacked pack to chain them in place, and reactivate it when you want the leap.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 376079 resolved by name lookup and verified against WCL game data; not pressed in the sampled parses. Class tree talent.

major_cooldowns.name: Light's Potential
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drink it on the pull with Recklessness and hero, and hold the second for adds, a burst phase, or Execute range.
major_cooldowns.id_note: One of the two combat potions the field runs; flagged talent_gated so a player on the other potion is not treated as never using it.

major_cooldowns.name: Potion of Recklessness
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drink it on the pull with Recklessness and hero, and time the second so its buff finishes before the fight ends.
major_cooldowns.id_note: One of the two combat potions the field runs; flagged talent_gated so a player on the other potion is not treated as never using it.

rule.description: Open with Charge into Recklessness and Rampage
rule.action: Charge on the pull, hit Recklessness in the same window, then Rampage to trigger Enrage.
Cast Rampage the moment Enrage is about to fall off instead of pooling rage through it.

rule.description: Spend Sudden Death procs on Execute
rule.action: Fire Execute while the proc is up, at any target health, since that cast is free.
Hold Bladestorm for your Recklessness window unless the boss is about to die.

rule.description: Battle Shout up before the pull
rule.action: Cast Battle Shout before the pull and put it straight back up if it ever drops.
